description: Address all 8 security and architecture issues identified in the semantic code review: role escalation, AI provider stubs, OAuth state forgery, tenant isolation gaps, Lambda-incompatible rate limiter, consent verification bypass, offline sync infinite retry, and DynamoDB auto-scaling misconfiguration.
steps: Add role allowlist validation in register handler (student, teacher, parent only for self-registration)
Add BedrockNotConfiguredError and OpenAINotConfiguredError classes with improved isAvailable() detection
Add HMAC-SHA256 signing/verification to DigiLocker OAuth state parameter
Wire enforceTenantIsolation into authenticateRequest middleware automatically
Implement DynamoDBRateLimitStore with atomic counters and TTL-based cleanup
Add ConsentManager.verifyConsentForProcessing calls in ABC and APAAR DPI handlers
Differentiate 4xx from network errors in service worker and ApiClient offline sync
Switch prod DynamoDB to PROVISIONED billing mode so auto-scaling is valid
acceptance_criteria: Self-registration rejects privileged roles (super_admin, tenant_admin, etc.)
AI provider isAvailable() returns false when using placeholder clients
DigiLocker callback rejects forged state parameters without valid HMAC
Auth middleware automatically rejects cross-tenant requests
DPI handlers reject invalid/expired/withdrawn consent artifacts
Offline sync removes permanently-failed 4xx mutations from queue
CDK synth succeeds with provisioned mode and auto-scaling in prod
findings: All 203 existing tests continue to pass. The auth middleware test works because when no X-Tenant-ID header is present, enforceTenantIsolation passes through (returning null). The consent verification in DPI handlers uses a pluggable ConsentStore interface that must be wired up in production. The DynamoDB rate limit store uses conditional expressions for atomic counter semantics.
